verdict.rationale: Penpot's integrations page documents outbound webhooks that notify other applications when events occur, such as a file being created or updated or a comment being added. That covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. The evidence is a single short first-party marketing description, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: a full event catalog, setup/subscription configuration docs, payload format and signature/security details, retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
